predecessors.name: Maya city-states (Preclassic and Classic)
predecessors.text: Naranjo (Sa'aal), 'about 50 km east of the site of Tikal' along the Mopan and Holmul rivers; 'at least 8 km2' with the urban centre about 2.25 km2

ledger.x: 546: the first dated ruler, Ah Wosaaj Chan K'inich, comes to power: 'Not much is known about the site before the ruler Ah Wosaaj Chan K'inich who came to power in 546 AD.'
546: 'Naranjo came under the control of Calakmul whose ruler Tuun Kab Hix appointed Ah Wosaaj Chan K'inich', 'a deliberate move by Calakmul to take allies away from Tikal'.
626: page silent on Naranjo leaving Calakmul; 'In 626 two attacks were made on Naranjo by Caracol' and Naranjo 'was then retaken by Calakmul in 631', which implies a lapse of Calakmul's control.
626: 'two attacks were made on Naranjo by Caracol'.
631: 'Naranjo was then retaken by Calakmul in 631', ending the Caracol hold on Naranjo.
631: 'Naranjo was then retaken by Calakmul in 631.'
About 695: page silent on any end to Calakmul's hold after 631; the date is a bridge placed in the 693-698 attacks, when Naranjo is recorded acting on its own account ('defeating Tikal in 695 AD').
810: 'Naranjo's final abandonment may have been the result of political turmoil and a severe drought dated to 810 AD'; the last dated text is Altar 2 of 790.

wars.name: Caracol-Naranjo star wars
wars.outcome: Two Caracol attacks in 626; Calakmul retook Naranjo in 631; Naranjo defeated Caracol in an undated 'star war' under K'ahk' Xiiw Chan Chaahk; 'by 680 Caracol had apparently recovered and eliminated K'ahk' Xiiw'.

wars.name: Naranjo's wars on Tikal, Ucanal and Yaxha
wars.outcome: 'Between 693 and 698 AD Naranjo carried out a series of at least eight attacks', 'defeating Tikal in 695 AD and Ucanal in 698 AD'; another series from 706 'including the defeat of Yaxha in 710'.

wars.name: Tikal's defeat of Naranjo
wars.outcome: 'Naranjo was defeated by Tikal in 744 AD and the ruler, Yax Mayuy Chan Chaak, was taken captive and likely sacrificed.'
